changelog:
- Fundraising & Contributing: Dedicated shortcut in the browser menu and About dialog to sponsor development via GitHub Sponsors or Buy Me a Coffee.
- Open to Code Contributors: Community contribution pathways directly linked to help report issues, build extensions, and submit PRs.
- Social App & Video Engine Stability: Resolved video audio issues and feed interruptions across YouTube, X (Twitter), and Instagram.
- Multi-Pane Focus Isolation: Enhanced text-input routing and touch dispatch in dual-deck multitasking mode.
